podcast.body: The second single from "Scary Monsters," this infectious, synth-driven, and danceable track was infused with R&B energy. It cracked the Hot 100 at a meager number 70 in America, but reached the top five in the UK, serving as a better indicator of Bowie's evolving, rhythmic pop sound for the 80s. "The only scary monster's track that did any business for Bowie in America was its second single, Fashion."

podcast.body: This song is mentioned as summarizing the topic of the show, highlighting the intertwined relationship between rock music and fashion. It served as an entry point for discussing the importance of visual style in music. "David Bowie with Fashion, which pretty much sums up the topic of the show."
